_doc: DRAFT master palette, NOT APPROVED. 56 colours in the named ramps of 06_STYLE_ART.md section 2, so the pipeline has a palette to quantise to and validate against. The palette size (48 / 56 / 64) and every colour are director decisions from sample set 3 (docs/specs/phase1_visual_proof.md section 5). Colour index = position in the flattened ramp list, in file order; never reorder an approved palette. Skin: only the neutral ramp the sprites render in; the six skin_1..6 recolour ramps are added when the director picks the size. heraldry is the only high-saturation ramp (faction cloth, shields, banners). blood is overlay-only, never in a base sprite.

ramps.name: skin_neutral
ramps.purpose: the one skin ramp sprites render in; recoloured by index

ramps.name: cloth_faded
ramps.purpose: commoner clothing: dull red, blue, green pairs

ramps.name: blood
ramps.purpose: overlay only: two reds and a dried brown
